title: Seazn Match Day code approval, v1: GET|POST /api/v1/match-day-code/approvals/{kind}/{stageId}
description: An approval as a phone holding a Match Day code reviews it (capture S4 Match Day design 2026-11-07 §7, §9.5; MD-1 Task 6): GET /api/v1/match-day-code/approvals/{kind}/{stageId}, kind swiss or draw, authenticated by Authorization: Bearer md_… only, and only for a code minted with "can approve draws". The root is the review, `data` in the v1 envelope {ok: true, data, requestId}. POST to the same path with $defs.request approves it and answers $defs.ok; $defs.refusal is `error` in {ok: false, error, requestId}. Nothing in it is a credential. Vendored into the capture repo; its sha256, parity with its zod twin and its fixtures are pinned by apps/web/src/server/api-v1/__tests__/capture-contract.test.ts.

kind.description: swiss (the next round of a Swiss stage) or draw (the seed proposal from groups into a knockout).

stage_id.description: The stage the approval acts on: the day read's approvals.stage_id.

round.description: swiss: the round awaiting pairing, the day read's approvals.round; the approve hands it back. draw: null.

rows.description: What the server computed, read-only, in order: swiss, one row per board of the round, the bye last with away null; draw, one row per knockout match a qualifier is drawn into, in round then match order. To change a slot, the organiser uses the web desk.

label.description: The row's place: the round as the web's board codes it (R4, QF, SF, F, …), then its number in the round when the round holds more than one (R4 1, QF 2).

away.description: The second side's name; null on a bye, or in a knockout match whose other seat is fed from elsewhere.

hash.description: What the approve hands back, unchanged: swiss, a hash of the round's inputs (results, field, stage settings and lots); draw, the proposal's id. An approve whose hash is no longer the server's is refused MD_STALE.

ties.description: draw only (swiss: false): the draw has a tie only the web desk can resolve. The phone shows it and does not approve it; an approve is refused MD_TIES.

request.description: The approve's body, POST /api/v1/match-day-code/approvals/{kind}/{stageId}: the review's hash, and for swiss its round.

round.description: swiss: the review's round (required: an approve without it is a 422). draw: omitted, or null.

ok.description: The approve's 200: this request approved it. The new matches are on the server at once; the phone refreshes its day read. A second phone's approve is the refusal MD_ALREADY, never this.

refusal.description: Every refusal, the envelope's error: 401 MD_UNKNOWN (no such code, or no md_ bearer), 410 MD_WITHDRAWN, 410 MD_ENDED, 403 MD_NOT_OPEN (with opens_at), 403 MD_NO_APPROVE (the code was minted without "can approve draws", or the division's schedule is locked — the desk's, and the day read lists none of its approvals: the review AND the approve), 403 MD_OUT_OF_SCOPE (the stage is not in the code's competition, or for a venue or courts code none of its matches is on those courts on the code's day), 409 MD_STALE (the hash is no longer the server's — a result, the field, a seat or the proposal changed — or the approval is not ready: the round before is still in play, the groups are not complete, or nobody is left to seed; review again; or a Swiss round 1, which only the web desk pairs), 409 MD_ALREADY (approved already: another phone or the desk was first), 409 MD_TIES (draw: a tie the web desk must resolve). Every 409 is one of these words. A 404 NOT_FOUND (no such stage, kind or proposal), a 422 (a swiss approve without a whole round, or a kind the stage has not: a swiss approval of a stage that is not a Swiss, a draw of a Swiss stage), any other 4xx refusal (by its status, with no word of its own), a 429 RATE_LIMITED (with Retry-After) and a 500 INTERNAL (a fault on the server) are the v1 envelope's own answers, outside this shape.

code.description: The machine word the phone keys its copy on: one of the plan's MD_ words, a closed list. The v1 envelope's own answers (429 RATE_LIMITED, 404 NOT_FOUND, 422, 500 INTERNAL) are not md_ refusals and are outside this shape; the phone reads them by status.

message.description: A plain English developer string; the phone never shows it.

opens_at.description: MD_NOT_OPEN only: when the code's day starts, as a UTC instant.
